subject: Kickoff: multi-annotator disagreement modeling for Corpus labeling
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kicking off the multi-annotator effort formally. Goal: bring the approach from our open-source release (train on every annotator's label instead of the majority vote) into the Corpus labeling pipeline for hate-speech detection, so downstream teams see disagreement rather than a fake single ground truth.

Scope for this half: (1) adapt the data format — N annotator columns named 0 to N-1 plus a text column, values 0/1/NaN — to Corpus export schemas; (2) extend preprocess.py beyond the two datasets it currently reformats; (3) a pilot eval against the majority-vote baseline.

Milestones I want to socialize at the next Launch Review Board: format validator by 04-03, pilot model trained by 04-24, integration readout before 05-25. If we land the pilot, this becomes the Q3 OKR anchor for data-platforms.

Can you confirm staffing this week?

Thanks,
Dmitri
